name: Barbell Thruster
instructions: Clean a barbell to the front-rack position, elbows high.
Drive up explosively, using the leg drive to help press the bar overhead.
Lock out over your mid-foot, lower to the rack, and flow straight into the next squat.
longevityNotes: Keep the squat pattern for life: depth and control matter more than load. Train it pain-free, leave reps in reserve, and your knees and hips will thank you at 80.
overview: Barbell Thruster is an intermediate lower-body exercise that builds the quadriceps, usually performed with a barbell. It trains the deep knee-and-hip bend you use every time you sit, stand, or climb stairs.
